events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in 1969.

angles.name: The Sound of '69
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace of Woodstock. Which legendary performance defined it for you?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Elvis Presley. His impact on music is simply unmatched. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Reflecting on the tragic death of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur today. His lyrics and impact continue to resonate decades later. What's your go-to Tupac anthem?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Commemorating the anniversary of the passing of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. The music is timeless, but that album cover is legendary.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy birthday to Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher, who turns 54 today.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger. What's your favourite Oasis hit?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon released the powerful 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the 25th anniversary of Apple's revolutionary first iPod release in 2001, which changed how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remember Your First iPod?
angles.copy: 25 years ago today, Apple launched the original iPod. Remember carrying your entire music library in your pocket for the first time?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: A True Icon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of comedy icon John Cleese, who turns 87 today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking self-titled album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary Sounds
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incredible Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
